Tempsens Instruments Shares Surge Over 110% on Debut

Tempsens Instruments made its stock market debut with a significant surge, with shares rallying over 110% on their first day of trading. The company's Initial Public Offering (IPO) was valued at $68 million. The stock's performance on debut has been described as a 'multibagger listing'.
